quests.instruction: What is the first letter of sled?
quests.hint: Point to each letter with your finger, starting on the left.
quests.explanation: The first letter of sled is S.
quests.funFact: Words can be short or long. 'I' has one letter, and 'alphabet' has eight.

quests.instruction: Look at spoon. Which letter is at the very end?
quests.hint: Point to each letter with your finger, starting on the left.
quests.explanation: In spoon, N is the last letter.
quests.funFact: In autumn, the last n is silent.

quests.instruction: Which letter can you find in the word sock?
quests.hint: Check each letter against the word, one at a time.
quests.explanation: sock is spelled s-o-c-k, so o is in it. a and e are not.
quests.funFact: In XOXO, X stands for a kiss and O stands for a hug.

quests.instruction: Look at the word city. Which letter is at the very start?
quests.hint: Say city one letter at a time and keep your place.
quests.explanation: city is spelled c-i-t-y. Its first letter is C.
quests.funFact: A word with a silent letter still needs that letter when you spell it.

quests.instruction: What is the last letter of dice?
quests.hint: Spell dice slowly: d-i-c-e.
quests.explanation: dice is spelled d-i-c-e. Its last letter is E.
quests.funFact: Lowercase e looks like a small circle with a line across the middle.

quests.instruction: Find the word that uses the letter k.
quests.hint: Spell each word in your head and look for a tall stick with a small arrow on its right.
quests.explanation: shark is spelled s-h-a-r-k, so it has k. raccoon and yoga do not.
quests.funFact: In knee, knife and know, the k at the start is silent.

quests.instruction: Which letter comes last in the word guitar?
quests.hint: guitar has 6 letters. Count them from the left, one finger per letter.
quests.explanation: In guitar, r is the last letter.
quests.funFact: R is a sound that takes practice; many children learn it later than other sounds.

quests.instruction: Look at ten. Which letter is hiding in it?
quests.hint: Spell ten out loud: t-e-n.
quests.explanation: ten is spelled t-e-n, so T is in it. I and L are not.
quests.funFact: In English, we read from left to right, so the first letter of a word is the first one we meet.

quests.instruction: Which letter comes first in the word pen?
quests.hint: Spell pen slowly: p-e-n.
quests.explanation: The first letter of pen is p.
quests.funFact: Sorting words by their first letter is the first step in using a dictionary.

quests.instruction: Which letter is in the middle of robot?
quests.hint: Spell robot slowly: r-o-b-o-t.
quests.explanation: The middle letter of robot is b.
quests.funFact: B has its roots in beta, the second letter of the Greek alphabet.

quests.instruction: Which letter comes first in the word lobster?
quests.hint: lobster has 7 letters. Count them from the left, one finger per letter.
quests.explanation: lobster is spelled l-o-b-s-t-e-r. Its first letter is L.
quests.funFact: Lowercase l is a single tall line.

quests.instruction: Which word has b as its last letter?
quests.hint: Check the last letter of each word.
quests.explanation: crab ends with b. ring ends with g and bell ends with l.
quests.funFact: Many words you see every day, like the, and, is and in, are made of just a few letters.

quests.instruction: One word has E hiding inside. Which one is it?
quests.hint: The letter E can be at the start, the middle or the end.
quests.explanation: ice is spelled i-c-e, so it has E. hat and ball do not.
quests.funFact: The letters 'ee' and 'ea' can both say 'ee', as in bee and sea.

quests.instruction: Hippo has a letter right in the middle. Which one is it?
quests.hint: Say hippo one letter at a time and keep your place.
quests.explanation: In hippo, P is the middle letter.
quests.funFact: Rhyming words often end with the same letters, like cat and hat.

quests.instruction: Which pair joins C to the same letter in small form?
quests.hint: Find C in each pair. Is the other letter its small twin, or a different letter?
quests.explanation: Cc is right. The other pairs do not have the same letter in both places.
quests.funFact: A few letters look quite different in the two forms, like a and A, g and G, or r and R.

quests.instruction: Which word ends with the letter R?
quests.hint: Look at the far right of each word. That is where words end.
quests.explanation: number ends with R. monkey ends with y and noodles ends with s.
quests.funFact: Changing just the first letter can make a brand-new word: cat, hat, bat, mat.

quests.instruction: Which of these letters is in bridge?
quests.hint: Check each letter against the word, one at a time.
quests.explanation: bridge is spelled b-r-i-d-g-e, so g is in it. f and q are not.
quests.funFact: You can learn new words by looking at their first and last letters.

quests.instruction: Find the middle letter of the word nut.
quests.hint: nut has 3 letters, so the middle one is number 2.
quests.explanation: nut is spelled n-u-t. Its middle letter is u.
quests.funFact: In cup and bus, u says its short sound 'uh'.

quests.instruction: What is the second letter of yellow? Count from the left.
quests.hint: Spell yellow slowly: y-e-l-l-o-w.
quests.explanation: In yellow, E is the second letter.
quests.funFact: E is a vowel. It can say 'eh' as in egg, or 'ee' as in tree.

quests.instruction: Which word contains a?
quests.hint: Say each word slowly, one letter at a time.
quests.explanation: fairy is spelled f-a-i-r-y, so it has a. nose and cherry do not.
quests.funFact: Every English word is built from the same 26 letters.

quests.instruction: Which letter comes last in the word mirror?
quests.hint: Say mirror one letter at a time and keep your place.
quests.explanation: The last letter of mirror is R.
quests.funFact: Letters inside a word can be hard to see at first, but they get easier the more you read.

quests.instruction: Cow has a letter right in the middle. Which one is it?
quests.hint: cow has 3 letters. Count them from the left, one finger per letter.
quests.explanation: cow is spelled c-o-w. Its middle letter is O.
quests.funFact: Octopus, otter and ox begin with the short o sound.

quests.instruction: Which letter is the second letter in boat?
quests.hint: boat has 4 letters. Count them from the left, one finger per letter.
quests.explanation: The second letter of boat is o.
quests.funFact: Orange and onion begin with O, but that O sounds different from the O in octopus.

quests.instruction: Find the word that finishes with N.
quests.hint: Look at the far right of each word. That is where words end.
quests.explanation: violin ends with N. potato ends with o and orange ends with e.
quests.funFact: In knee and knot, the k is silent, so the word begins with an 'nnn' sound.

quests.instruction: Which word has the letter s in it?
quests.hint: Say each word slowly, one letter at a time.
quests.explanation: rose is spelled r-o-s-e, so it has s. web and mirror do not.
quests.funFact: S says 'sss', like a snake or a slow leak from a tire.

quests.instruction: Which letter is the third letter in dress?
quests.hint: Spell dress slowly: d-r-e-s-s.
quests.explanation: In dress, E is the third letter.
quests.funFact: Many words end with a silent e, like cake and bike, and it helps the vowel say its name.

quests.instruction: Which of these letters is in helmet?
quests.hint: Spell helmet out loud: h-e-l-m-e-t.
quests.explanation: helmet is spelled h-e-l-m-e-t, so M is in it. V and W are not.
quests.funFact: Your lips stay closed to say 'mmm', and the sound comes out through your nose.

quests.instruction: What is the second letter of monkey? Count from the left.
quests.hint: Say monkey one letter at a time and keep your place.
quests.explanation: In monkey, o is the second letter.
quests.funFact: The letters 'oo' can say 'oo' as in moon, or a shorter sound as in book.

quests.instruction: Find the word that finishes with T.
quests.hint: Check the last letter of each word.
quests.explanation: goat ends with T. hen ends with n and bike ends with e.
quests.funFact: T says 'tuh', a quick tap of your tongue behind your top teeth.

quests.instruction: Match the small e with its capital letter.
quests.hint: Some small letters and capitals look alike and some do not. Check the name: 'ee'.
quests.explanation: Capital E, small e. Compare Earth and earth. A word to remember it by: Earth.
quests.funFact: Elephant, egg and elf begin with the short e sound.
